strong_external_comparator.bandwidth: kappa times the 90th percentile of observed finest-SWT local robust scales; no clean reference, true injected sigma or masks used
strong_external_comparator.selection: same development active cap and quiet objective; declare infeasible and fallback to minimum whole NMSE if needed
strong_external_comparator.author_demo_setting: kappa=0.6 separately retained as fixed reference with the declared input-only scale estimator
strong_external_comparator.boundaries: author code leaves first patch_half_width+1 and last patch_half_width samples NaN; port returns input there. All primary/control scoring excludes one second, so these filled samples do not enter endpoints
strong_external_comparator.scope: reliable author-core comparator for morphology-preserving denoising; not a claim of current state of the art, nor reproduction of all original paper tables
